name: @forguncy-react-workspace/dependency-resolver
//dependencies: `rolldown` is the bundler the Cell compiler uses (#7), pinned to the version
this toolchain installs (`vite-plus@0.3.2`). The probe engine's `build` step
runs the candidate fixture through the same Vite+/Rolldown stack Cell
compilation uses (#17), so a probe result is evidence about the artifact the
cell would actually ship rather than about a different bundler's output.
`@babel/parser` is the scanner's comment and import reader (`probe/module-source.ts`),
pinned to the same 7.29 line `cell-compiler` uses and the target ships
(`RUNTIME_CONTRACT_TARGET.browserTranspiler`, #5). It is the same tool for the same
reason source-guard.ts records: telling code from comment text by regular expression
is not a solved problem, and the failure mode here was a package refused for a
specifier that only ever appeared in a JSDoc `@example` block. Nothing it provides
can reach a Cell artifact, so per AGENTS.md it is not a host/inline/extension/replace
decision; it is pinned rather than floated so a grammar change cannot arrive silently.
